identity.mission: Create a digital soul mirror that reflects human emotion through code and pixel. Avoid generic SaaS aesthetics. Embrace mystery, depth, and fluid motion.

tertiary.name: Space Mono
tertiary.usage: Data visualization, AI Analysis stats, timestamps

layout.grid_system: Use a centralized layout for the main 'Mirror' experience. 12-column grid for history/dashboard sections.

MoodOrb.description: The central visual element. A div with heavy blur and gradient that shifts based on current mood state.
MoodOrb.styles: rounded-full filter blur-3xl transition-all duration-1000 ease-in-out absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-60 mix-blend-screen

InputTabs.description: Floating glass tabs to switch between Text, Draw, Speak.
InputTabs.styles: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-full p-1

GlassCard.description: Container for analysis results and content.
GlassCard.styles: bg-[#0A0A0A]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5 shadow-2xl rounded-2xl p-8

ActionButtons.description: Minimalist, pill-shaped buttons with subtle glow on hover.
ActionButtons.styles: px-8 py-3 rounded-full font-medium transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 border border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]

libraries.charts: react-chartjs-2 (Use 'Radar' or 'PolarArea' charts for emotion mapping, customized to be dark and glowing)
libraries.drawing: react-canvas-draw (Customize canvas background to be transparent or dark)
libraries.ui: shadcn/ui (Heavily customized: remove radii, add glass effects)

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text opacity is high enough on dark backgrounds (min 0.8 opacity for body).
accessibility.motion_reduction: Respect prefers-reduced-motion using framer-motion's useReducedMotion hook.
accessibility.screen_readers: All mood visualizers must have aria-labels describing the current mood state.

instructions_to_main_agent: PHASE 1: Set up the 'Atmosphere'. Create a Layout wrapper that holds the dark background, fonts, and global animations.
PHASE 2: Build the 'Express Yourself' input components. The drawing canvas should feel like drawing with light on a dark screen. The voice input should visualize sound waves.
PHASE 3: Implement the Mood Logic. Mock the AI response first to perfect the transitions. When the user submits, the 'Mirror' should swirl/blur before revealing the result.
PHASE 4: Create the 'Result Card'. It should display the generated poem/text with elegant typography and a mood chart.
CRITICAL: Do not use standard white cards. Everything is dark, glass, and glowing.
For the Chart, use a Polar Area chart where each segment is a mood color. It looks more 'artistic' than a bar chart.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry where possible, but keep the core interaction focused.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are recommended for the background.
